admin_head: Ministère de la poste et des télécommunications
spending_entity: Ministère de la poste et des télécommunications (Algérie)
purpose: The telecommunications-development programme of Algeria's posts and telecommunications ministry, split into two sub-programmes: ICT infrastructure development and security, and radiocommunication and sensitive telecommunications equipment.
scope_basis: Named telecommunications-development programme of the sector ministry; single-purpose by name.
amount_scale: Dinars algériens (DA), the gazette's own unit, at full precision as printed
doc_locator: *Journal officiel* n° 02 du 11 janvier 2026, **décret exécutif n° 26-43 du 7 janvier 2026**, état annexé, programme `Développement des télécommunications`
notes: `appropriated_total` carries the CP, not the AE, and the record says so on its face.** Algeria appropriates in two axes — *autorisations d'engagement* (commitment authority) and *crédits de paiement* (payment credits) — and conflating them would be the exact error the domestic-state driver warns against. CP is the cash the year authorises; AE is recorded alongside and never summed with it. *(CC decision, 2026-08-04.)* · Investment is appropriated in CP but not in AE.** Titre 3 carries **924,620,000 DA of crédits de paiement against no new autorisations d'engagement** — the signature of paying down commitments already engaged rather than starting new work. Read on its own, the DZD 13.17m AE figure would suggest Algeria appropriated almost nothing for telecommunications in 2026; it appropriated almost no *new* commitment. · The postal comparator.** The same decree gives *Développement des services postaux* **8,746,230,000 DA** in both AE and CP, of which 8,740,000,000 DA is the Titre 4 transfer carrying Algérie Poste's subsidy. The posts vote exceeds the telecommunications vote nine times over on CP and several hundred times over on AE. That is a subsidy to an operator, not sector development, and it is recorded separately rather than netted here. · Whole-ministry envelope**, for context and not for aggregation: AE 14,688,390,000 DA / CP 15,866,176,000 DA (`Article 1er` of the decree). · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named, dated DZD/USD rate for FY2026 is held; a dollar figure would be an undated conversion, which `CLAUDE.md` → *Currency* forbids.

admin_head: Ministère de l'intérieur, des collectivités locales et de l'aménagement du territoire
purpose: The programme carrying Algeria's identity, title and secure-document estate, inside the interior ministry's vote rather than the posts and telecommunications ministry's or the Haut-Commissariat à la numérisation's.
scope_basis: Named identity-and-secure-documents programme; single-purpose by name, covering the national identity card, passport and secure-title estate.
amount_scale: Dinars algériens (DA), the gazette's own unit, at full precision as printed
doc_locator: *Journal officiel* n° 02 du 11 janvier 2026, **décret exécutif n° 26-26 du 7 janvier 2026**, état annexé, programme `Identité, titres et documents sécurisés`
notes: This is the largest single digital line in the Algerian FY2026 budget the wiki holds, and it sits with Interior.** At DZD 12.32bn CP it is roughly thirteen times the whole *Développement des télécommunications* programme's CP and an order of magnitude larger than the posts ministry's entire non-postal appropriation. Where a state's identity money sits is a governance fact: in Algeria it sits with the police-and-territory ministry, not with the digital-transformation machinery. · `appropriated_total` carries the CP, not the AE**, per the same rule applied to every FY2026 Algerian line in this batch; AE is recorded alongside and never summed with it. · Investment is the growing part.** Titre 3 runs 1,100,000,000 DA AE against 2,060,000,000 DA CP — payment credits nearly double the new engagement authority. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named, dated DZD/USD rate for FY2026 is held; a dollar figure would be an undated conversion, which `CLAUDE.md` → *Currency* forbids.

purpose: The programme carrying digitalisation of public services, inside the interior ministry's vote.
scope_basis: Named public-service-digitalisation programme; single-purpose by name.
amount_scale: Dinars algériens (DA), the gazette's own unit, at full precision as printed
doc_locator: *Journal officiel* n° 02 du 11 janvier 2026, **décret exécutif n° 26-26 du 7 janvier 2026**, état annexé, programme `Numérisation du service public`
notes: The service-digitalisation programme is not with the digital-transformation machinery either.** Like the identity estate, it sits with Interior — not with the posts and telecommunications ministry and not with the Haut-Commissariat à la numérisation, whose own appropriation is not identified in this decree. · This is the one digital line in the batch where AE exceeds CP** — 393,900,000 DA of commitment authority against 303,900,000 DA of payment credits, driven by Titre 3 (290m AE against 200m CP). New work is being engaged faster than it is being paid for, the mirror image of the telecommunications programme. · Small against the identity estate.** At DZD 303.9m CP it is about **2.5%** of the *Identité, titres et documents sécurisés* programme in the same ministry's vote. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named, dated DZD/USD rate for FY2026 is held; a dollar figure would be an undated conversion, which `CLAUDE.md` → *Currency* forbids.

admin_head: Ministère de la poste et des télécommunications
spending_entity: Ministère de la poste et des télécommunications (Algérie)
line_name: Développement des services postaux — Développement des services financiers postaux
purpose: The postal financial services sub-programme of the posts and telecommunications ministry's postal vote — the ministry-side appropriation for the rails Algérie Poste runs.
scope_basis: Named sub-programme for postal financial services — Algérie Poste's CCP and card rails are the country's dominant retail payment infrastructure, so the sub-programme is recorded rather than the whole postal programme.
amount_scale: Dinars algériens (DA), the gazette's own unit, at full precision as printed
doc_locator: *Journal officiel* n° 02 du 11 janvier 2026, **décret exécutif n° 26-43 du 7 janvier 2026**, état annexé, sous-programme `Développement des services financiers postaux`
notes: The sub-programme is recorded, not the parent postal programme, and the reason is scope.** *Développement des services postaux* carries **8,746,230,000 DA**, of which **8,740,000,000 DA** is a Titre 4 transfer — Algérie Poste's operating subsidy, which is a subsidy to a postal operator and not digital-payments spend. Carrying the parent line as `dpi.pay` would have put 8.7bn DA of postal subsidy into Algeria's digital-payments aggregate. Only the named financial-services sub-programme is recorded. *(CC decision, 2026-08-04.)* · DZD 1.62 million is the whole ministry-side appropriation for postal financial services**, in a country where Algérie Poste's CCP accounts and Edahabia cards are the mass-market payment instrument. The money that actually runs those rails is inside Algérie Poste's own accounts and the Titre 4 subsidy, neither of which this decree breaks out — an absence worth stating rather than a figure worth doubting. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named, dated DZD/USD rate for FY2026 is held; a dollar figure would be an undated conversion, which `CLAUDE.md` → *Currency* forbids.
